{
  "package_manager": "pnpm",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:vscode",
    "build:core": "pnpm --filter @pre-cr/core build",
    "build:server": "pnpm --filter @pre-cr/server build",
    "build:vscode": "pnpm --filter pre-cr-suite build",
    "typecheck": "turbo run typecheck",
    "test": "turbo run test",
    "lint": "turbo run lint",
    "package": "pnpm run build && pnpm --filter pre-cr-suite package",
    "clean": "pnpm -r run clean && rm -rf node_modules",
    "dev": "turbo run dev --parallel"
  },
  "checks": [
    {
      "category": "typecheck",
      "script": "typecheck",
      "required": false,
      "suggested": "tsc --noEmit",
      "exists": true,
      "command": "pnpm run typecheck"
    },
    {
      "category": "lint",
      "script": "lint",
      "required": true,
      "suggested": "eslint .",
      "exists": true,
      "command": "pnpm run lint"
    },
    {
      "category": "test",
      "script": "test",
      "required": false,
      "suggested": "vitest run or npm test equivalent",
      "exists": true,
      "command": "pnpm run test"
    },
    {
      "category": "coverage",
      "script": "test:coverage",
      "required": false,
      "suggested": "vitest run --coverage or project equivalent",
      "exists": false,
      "command": null
    },
    {
      "category": "package",
      "script": "package:dry-run",
      "required": false,
      "suggested": "npm pack --dry-run",
      "exists": false,
      "command": null
    },
    {
      "category": "build",
      "script": "build",
      "required": false,
      "suggested": "framework build command",
      "exists": true,
      "command": "pnpm run build"
    }
  ]
}
